mappings.rationale: Grammar interprets what the sentence is trying to achieve (Narrative Function + Viewer Effect) before seeking visual solutions.
Before cutting, the system asks whether an editorial reason exists to change the screen state, preventing timer-based cutting.
Categorizing beats into SUPPORTING, MEANINGFUL, MAJOR, and HERO dictates emphasis intensity.
Decoupling what is mentioned (Subject) from how it is framed (Function) stops naive keyword substring cutting.
Presenter presence is recognized as a narrative asset, ensuring the human guide conducts the arc.
